item.title: Photos show families around the world honoring the dead with flowers, candles and prayers
item.description: Families around the world honor the dead with flowers, candles and prayers. Day of the Dead, observed Nov. 1-2, All Saints' Day on Nov. 1 and All Souls' Day on Nov. 2 bring communities together to remember loved ones through colorful altars, cemetery visits and religious services.

item.title: Rubio meets Venezuelan counterpart as US presses for progress on election preparations
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has met with his Venezuelan counterpart in Washington. The meeting comes as the Trump administration has stepped up efforts to press the country’s interim government and opposition groups to make quick progress on preparations for elections that could be held next year

item.title: Trump forgoes traditional campaign trail stops in final push before midterm Election Day
item.description: As Republicans and Democrats were making their final pitch to voters on Election Day eve, President Donald Trump was instead planning to speak far away from most of the people his party is trying to persuade.

item.title: The Trump administration will cut South Africa and Rwanda from the AGOA trade program
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump will cut South Africa and Rwanda from the AGOA trade agreement at the end of the year as punishment for not meeting certain criteria.
